page_subtitle: Choose which details your storefront asks for, and add questions of your own.
cache_notice: Changes can take a few minutes to show on product pages that visitors have already loaded.

fields.section_subtitle: What the order form asks every shopper.
fields.customerName_why: Carriers need a name for the parcel.
fields.phone_why: How you confirm the order, and how a customer is recognised on their next one.
fields.commune_why: Sets the delivery price and the carrier's destination.
fields.address_hint: Asked for home delivery only. Cannot be turned off — carriers need it to deliver.
fields.notes_hint: Hiding this makes checkout shorter, and customers can no longer leave delivery instructions.
fields.email_hint: Saved on the order. Becomes required automatically if you start selling digital products.

delivery.section_subtitle: The choices a shopper sees. At least one must stay on.
delivery.last_one_hint: Keep at least one delivery option on — a form with neither takes no orders.

custom.section_subtitle: Up to {max} extra questions, asked after the delivery details.
custom.label: Question
custom.answers_note: Answers appear on the order in your dashboard. They are never sent to carriers.
custom.limit_reached: You have reached the maximum of {max} questions.
custom.empty_hint: Add a question when you need something the standard fields don't cover.

errors.load_failed: Could not load the checkout form settings.
errors.save_failed: Could not save the checkout form.
errors.no_delivery_option: Keep at least one delivery option on — otherwise no one can place an order.
errors.label_too_long: A question title is too long.
errors.duplicate_label: Two questions cannot have the same title.
errors.options_required: A list question needs at least one choice.
errors.duplicate_options: Choices must be different from each other.
errors.too_many_options: Too many choices for one question.
